overview_description.description: Mthmr is pioneering the intersection of fintech and advertising in the MENA region through card-linked offers, powered by open banking. In a market where advertisers struggle to effectively target consumers and banks aim to personalize rewards, our platform offers a win-win. Advertisers get precise insights on customer behavior, and banks can offer personalized, merchant-funded rewards, boosting loyalty. We've identified a sizable opportunity in MENA, and with our dedicated team and unique approach, we aim to redefine how consumers, banks, and advertisers interact.

product.name: Personalized Cashback Rewards
product.description: A platform feature that uses anonymized transaction data to create customized cashback rewards for customers, enhancing engagement and loyalty.

product.name: Targeted Promotions
product.description: A service that leverages transaction data to design and deliver promotions aimed at specific customer segments, driving sales and customer retention.

product.name: Real-time Campaign Performance Tracking
product.description: A tool that allows advertisers and financial institutions to monitor the effectiveness of their marketing campaigns in real-time, enabling data-driven adjustments.

product.name: Data-Driven Marketing Solutions
product.description: A suite of services that use data analytics to optimize marketing strategies, helping brands and financial institutions increase customer engagement and ROI.
